name: audio-device-settings
description: Switch input/output audio devices and mute the input via SwitchAudioSource
author: yug1224

scripts.check: pnpm run lint:check && pnpm run type:check && pnpm run fmt:check

commands.name: input
commands.title: Set Input Audio Device
commands.description: List and switch the active input audio device

commands.name: output
commands.title: Set Output Audio Device
commands.description: List and switch the active output audio device

commands.name: mute
commands.title: Mute the input audio device
commands.description: Mute the input audio device using Core Audio

commands.name: unmute
commands.title: Unmute the input audio device
commands.description: Unmute the input audio device and restore the previous level

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle input audio device mute
commands.description: Toggle input audio device mute on or off

title: audio-device-settings
